title: Autonomous Underwater vehicle
description:
My underwater robotics work began through university competitions such as SAUVC and RoboSub and has grown into more than seven years of hands on engineering. I contributed to onboard machine learning, computer vision, hardware design, and team leadership. Our team placed runner up at RoboSub 2023. I also worked with NVIDIA TK, TX, and Jetson platforms, explored reinforcement learning for navigation, and developed tether communications and efficient video transmission for underwater operations.
Key Highlights
•	More than seven years of involvement in underwater robotics, beginning with SAUVC and continuing through RoboSub.
•	RoboSub 2023 runner up achievement.
•	Led work spanning onboard machine learning, computer vision, hardware design, implementation, and team coordination.
•	Worked with NVIDIA TK, TX, and Jetson computing platforms.
•	Explored reinforcement learning for navigation, alongside tether communications and efficient video transmission.

title: Nabik Automations Inc.
description:
Nabik Automations grew from my experience building underwater robots into a startup focused on practical marine industry problems. I founded the company to develop robotic solutions for vessel inspection and repair. My work includes product development, electromechanical component design, robot software, and rapid prototyping with 3D printing. The role combines hands on engineering with product thinking, from understanding operational challenges to developing technology for real world marine applications.
Key Highlights
•	Founded an underwater robotics startup based on practical experience in the field.
•	Developing robotic products for marine vessel inspection and repair applications.
•	Designed multiple electromechanical components.
•	Contributed to robot software development and product level integration.
•	Used 3D printing for prototyping and explored Lattice SDK.

title: Military Project
category: Robotics, Autonomous and Remotely Operated Systems
description:
I contributed to the development of a tracked unmanned ground vehicle for the Bangladesh military, primarily intended for remote bomb disposal. My work included designing and building the tank tread mechanism and metal chassis, alongside embedded electronics and remote communications. The system used 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz communications and multi path communication practices. I also worked with STM32, LoRa, and NRF platforms on this and other projects, including a remotely operated extendable manipulation arm. Some project details remain confidential.
Key Highlights
•	Developed a tracked unmanned ground vehicle for a military application, primarily focused on remote bomb disposal.
•	Designed and built tank treads and a metal chassis.
•	Worked with 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz communications and multi path communication practices.
•	Worked with STM32, LoRa, and NRF based embedded systems.
•	Contributed to additional restricted projects, including a remotely operated extendable manipulation arm.

title: System on Chip Machine Learning Deployment
category: Edge AI, Computer Vision, Embedded Software
description:
This project focused on deploying custom object detection models on resource constrained system on chip platforms. I developed machine learning models and optimized them for devices such as Raspberry Pi, targeting approximately 30 frames per second. The deployed perception system was integrated with robots so detections could inform physical actions. The work covered model development, performance optimization, and hardware integration, bringing AI out of the desktop environment and onto practical robotic platforms.
Key Highlights
•	Developed custom object detection models.
•	Optimized inference for resource constrained SoC platforms, including Raspberry Pi.
•	Targeted approximately 30 frames per second on the deployed platform.
•	Integrated perception outputs with robotic systems so detections could drive actions.
•	Worked across Python, C++, CUDA, and performance optimization.

title: Reinforcement Learning in Image Processing
description:
My undergraduate research explored the application of reinforcement learning to image processing. I implemented learning agents and reward mechanisms, and investigated how reward bias can influence agent behaviour and results. The work combined practical experimentation with Python, CUDA, cuDNN, and neural networks. It strengthened my understanding of learning objectives and agent design, and resulted in a research paper published through IEEE.
Key Highlights
•	Undergraduate research into reinforcement learning techniques for image processing.
•	Implemented agents and reward mechanisms for experimental evaluation.
•	Investigated reward bias and its influence on agent behaviour.
•	Worked with Python, CUDA, cuDNN, and neural networks.
•	Research publication available through IEEE.

title: University Rover Challenge
description:
As part of the BRACU Mongol Tori Mars Rover Team, I contributed to rover development for the University Rover Challenge, an international university robotics competition. My work focused mainly on mechanical and electromechanical systems, including tracked wheel assemblies, a metal chassis, and custom 3D printed parts. I also worked with 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz communications and rover control software, bringing mechanical design, electronics, and software together in a mobile robotic platform.
Key Highlights
•	Contributed to BRACU Mongol Tori for the University Rover Challenge.
•	Designed and built rover mechanical and electromechanical components.
•	Built tracked wheel assemblies and a metal chassis.
•	Produced custom 3D printed parts.
•	Worked with wireless communications and rover control software.

title: Line Following Robot Champion
description:
I designed and built a custom line following robot to navigate complex competition tracks as quickly and reliably as possible. The platform featured a custom chassis and custom PCB boards, with control logic developed using Arduino, C, and C++. The work involved integrating the electronics and mechanical design, then testing and refining the robot's response to the track. The robot won the competition by achieving the fastest completion time.
Key Highlights
•	Designed and built a custom line following robot for complex competition tracks.
•	Developed a custom chassis and PCB boards.
•	Implemented robot logic using Arduino, C, and C++.
•	Won the competition by achieving the fastest completion time.

title: acciGone
description:
At acciGone, I worked on automotive safety product development, contributing to an Advanced Driver Assistance System (ADAS). My work included implementing machine learning components, training and testing custom models, and collecting datasets to support development. I used Python and TensorFlow and also contributed to UI and UX design and hardware interfacing. Gathering user feedback and applying it to interface improvements helped connect technical development with the needs of real users.
Key Highlights
•	Contributed to the development of an automotive safety product incorporating ADAS functionality.
•	Implemented machine learning components and trained and tested custom models.
•	Collected and prepared large datasets for model development.
•	Worked with Python, TensorFlow, and custom neural networks.
•	Contributed to UI and UX design, hardware interfacing, and user feedback driven improvements.

title: Drone Mapping
category: Aerial Robotics, UAV Systems, Geospatial Mapping
description:
This project involved building a custom unmanned aerial vehicle for terrain mapping. I worked on drone hardware, aerial navigation, and control, including the use of ArduPilot. The project brought together the aircraft platform and the systems needed to operate it as a mapping tool. It provided practical experience integrating UAV hardware, flight control, navigation, and mapping workflows to collect useful information about terrain.
Key Highlights
•	Built a custom UAV for terrain mapping.
•	Worked on drone hardware and platform integration.
•	Worked with aerial vehicle navigation, ArduPilot, mapping, and control systems.

title: Nano Satellite Ground Station
description:
I worked on building a radio communications ground station for a university nanosatellite initiative. To strengthen my radio communications skills, I acquired an amateur radio licence and operated under the callsign S21KG. My contributions included ground station development and custom antenna work for satellite communications. The associated nanosatellite, BRAC Onnesha, was launched aboard a SpaceX mission, connecting the project to a real space technology programme.
Key Highlights
•	Built a radio communications ground station for a university nanosatellite project.
•	Acquired an amateur radio licence and operated with callsign S21KG.
•	Worked on custom antenna development for satellite communications.
•	BRAC Onnesha was launched aboard a SpaceX mission.
